messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] welcome message for stan-users
parts:
Done. So, if you find yourself responding to a common problem on stan-users (forgetting to constrain a variable, looping instead of vectorizing, trying to sample integer parameters, etc.) it would be better to post under the FAQ thread

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/stan-users/4gv3fNCqSNk/X95DtUBCGCwJ

Be sure to change the subject and make the first sentence of your reply descriptive of the problem. Then reply to the OP and include a link to your response on the FAQ thread. You can find this link in the Google Groups interface but clicking on the drop-down box that says "Post reply" and selecting "Link". Conversely, it would probably be good to link to the OP's thread at the end of your response on the FAQ thread.

Also, the first four posts on the FAQ thread give instructions for dealing with parser / compiler / runtime / rstan errors so when someone says "Stan is not working!!!" but doesn't provide the necessary information to fix the problem, refer them to the appropriate direct link.

Ben
